_comment: Triage settings (issues #11, #12, #33). Thresholds are placeholders until the eval sweep (#21) gives the F2-best value. label_periods and list_factor belong to `triage.cli relevance` (docs/ISSUE_RECALL.md): quarters with known Suva selection, and the multiplier on the F2 threshold (1.0 = best F2, lower = longer list and higher recall; 0.3 found all 59 Suva judgements of the two labelled quarters). The relevance value is shown on this file's 0-100 scale: list threshold = green_threshold.
